skill.name: weibo-topic-analysis
skill.description: 当用户需要做微博选题、微博内容选题、热点观察、内容方向规划、竞品内容对比或选题素材整理时使用。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Search Weibo posts through SocialDataX and turn a limited sample into content ideas and research notes.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick alerts are Markdown syntax, but the CLI workflow runs unpinned npm code in an environment that can contain service credentials. The shell example does not specify safe argument handling, and billing guidance needs explicit URL validation. No evidence was found of embedded secrets or instructions to override the audit.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm execution in a credential-bearing environment
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review the CLI and its dependencies. Require approval before installing it, then run it with only the service credential and permissions it needs.

remediation.issue: User and service inputs may be interpolated into shell commands
remediation.suggestion: Replace the shell template with a structured tool call or a subprocess argument array without shell parsing. Pass keywords and pagination tokens as separate arguments.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads credentials from the environment or stores them in a local file
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a managed secret store or OS keychain. Verify documented file permissions, redact credentials in diagnostics, and document how to revoke or remove a saved key.

remediation.issue: An API error can supply a billing link
remediation.suggestion: Always display the fixed HTTPS billing URL from the documentation. Do not forward a link from an API error.

content.user_title: Analyze Weibo Topics for Content Planning
content.value_statement: A Weibo search can return more posts than a team can review quickly. This skill turns a bounded sample into traceable examples and topic ideas.
actual_capabilities: Search Weibo posts by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP search tool.
Limit CLI retrieval by pages or items and resume the same query with a returned pagination token.
Record returned post links, IDs, author details, engagement metrics, and publication times when available.
Group relevant examples into topic angles and separate observed evidence from editorial judgment.
Retain results from a partial CLI response and label the sample as incomplete.
limitations: Live searches need an authenticated SocialDataX connection and may use account credits.
Search results are a sample, not a complete archive or a reliable measure of overall popularity.
The Weibo workflow is read-only and does not post, comment, like, or change accounts.
Post fields depend on what the service returns, and the documented CLI workflow uses an unpinned npm package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Content Calendar
use_cases.description: Review a small keyword sample and identify recurring questions that could become calendar topics.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Content
use_cases.description: Compare examples from two brand searches and cite posts that illustrate differences in messaging.

use_cases.title: Choose a Post Angle
use_cases.description: Collect examples around one subject and identify a useful question that the sample leaves unanswered.

prompt_templates.title: Start With One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: A first look at a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Weibo posts for [keyword]. List up to five relevant examples with links or IDs and explain why they match.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Examples Into Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning posts for a specific audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [topic] and stop at 20 results. Group relevant posts by recurring question, then suggest three content angles for [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brand Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo separately for [brand A] and [brand B], with the same item limit for each. Cite examples and distinguish observations from interpretations.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a Partial Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Completing a bounded search after an interruption
prompt_templates.prompt: After the error is resolved, resume [query] only if a continuation token is available. Keep the original cumulative limits and report any remaining gaps.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review one page for commuter rain gear and suggest a post angle.
output: Sample observation: Several example posts discuss keeping bags dry during the commute.
Suggested angle: Compare bag covers and waterproof backpacks for short trips.
Scope: One page can suggest ideas but cannot show how common this concern is across Weibo.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize a coffee maker search that stopped after a partial response.
output: Coverage: The search returned 12 of 20 requested results before stopping.
Preliminary observation: The available examples discuss cleaning and counter space.
Next step: Resume only after resolving the error and only with a returned continuation token.

best_practices: Start with one page or a small item limit. Expand only if the sample does not answer the question.
Keep available links or post IDs and label editorial judgments separately from observed evidence.
Use non-sensitive keywords and prefer an approved, authenticated MCP connection when available.
anti_patterns: Treating a limited sample as a complete picture of Weibo activity.
Pasting an API key into chat, a prompt, or a command visible to the assistant.
Automatically restarting a partial search from page one when no continuation token is available.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a focused keyword or topic. An audience, brand, or scenario can help narrow the search.

faq.question: Do I need to set up a separate API key for MCP?
faq.answer: Not for an already authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection. The CLI needs its own credential in the environment where it runs.

faq.question: Can this skill retrieve every matching Weibo post?
faq.answer: No. The search has no stable boundary for complete results. Set a page or item limit.

faq.question: What can I cite from a result?
faq.answer: Use the post link or ID when available. Author details, engagement metrics, and publication times can provide additional context.

faq.question: Can a search use account credits?
faq.answer: Yes. If your balance is insufficient, stop retries and check the account balance directly in SocialDataX.

faq.question: Does this skill post or modify anything on Weibo?
faq.answer: No. It searches posts and summarizes the returned sample.
